1. Planes and interfaces per docs/phase2/ARCHITECTURE.md section 1 and 2; Phase 1 code per plane as listed there.
2. P0 has no SUMO run of record (SC-22): every message-path result uses MockMobility (--simulate).
3. P1 has no radio, MAC or channel model; the back-haul is an in-process bus (register #44-#48 conditions).
4. P2 gas is M1 (in-process Hardhat, chain 31337); no M2 (public testnet) run exists (N-11).
5. Counts on P5 and P6 are read from docs/figures/dashboard_snapshot.json (grand run at c4b35ce).
6. Balloon numbers refer to the bill of materials; each item names the directory or file it stands for.
